output dimensions: requested 2048 × 2048 pixels.
top-left tile: straight-on thin worn reflective silver/chrome souvenir-rack metal surface, soft gray chrome streaks and warm brown tarnish, opaque and usable as a material for metal wire geometry; no modeled rack silhouette.

bottom-left tile: dense red and hot-pink decorative feather/fiber surface inspired by the rack decoration at the lower-right of the photo, flat texture with natural frayed fibers.
bottom-right tile: worn warm copper/bronze surface inspired by the lantern metal in the original photo, soft orange-brown tarnish and subtle scratches.
